title: Three Terms and One Short Tube
subtitle: 未来展望 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 未来展望（宇宙探索·未来与展望）
meta: 主题语境：未来展望（宇宙探索·未来与展望）　|　核心词汇：telescope　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 telescope 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the researcher ① used the telescope that no student in the lab would have noted, and he said the using was the whole of the term. The ② telescope, meaning the instrument itself and not the tube, ran three terms and stayed unnoted in the book; a telescope, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ telescope in that lab had the same short tube beside it, and the ④ telescope at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A telescope, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the researcher said the noting is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the telescope was the whole of the matter, meaning the vision and not the instrument. The ⑥ telescope, meaning the vision and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; telescope, he said, is either something you use or the only word that means both an instrument and a vision. He said the vision is the part they remember.

By 1983 the ⑦ telescope had become a line in a paper, and the paper had become an argument about the short tube. The ⑧ telescope of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in February, was one lab and three terms of noting; telescope, he said, is either the sample at the far bench or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ telescope I remember is the instrument noted in the paper, which closed in 1985 and is still noted as the quietest in the lab. A ⑩ telescope, my mother said in 1987, is the only instrument that improves by being noted; every telescope, she said, is a vision that has agreed to look like an instrument. She said the vision was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 望远镜（指实验室里每一架旁边的那一架）
B. n. 望远镜（指那架望远镜本身，与细细的试管相对）
C. 固定搭配：use the telescope 用这一架望远镜
D. n. 望远镜（指留给孩子们测的那一份）
E. n. 望远镜之事（抽象总称，指一处实验室的望远镜之事）
F. n. 望远镜（指研究报告里写到、被记下的那一架）
G. n. 望远镜、眼界（指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 眼界（抽象总称，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: used the telescope that no student in the lab would have noted
The telescope, meaning the instrument itself and not the tube
the telescope at the far bench
the telescope was the whole of the matter
the telescope had become a line in a paper
The telescope of the whole thing
A telescope, my mother said in 1987

answers.why: use the telescope 意为“用这一架望远镜”，1978 年那位研究员把实验室里没有一位学生肯记下的一架望远镜做了一遍。
telescope 意为“望远镜”，指那架望远镜本身而不是细细的试管，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记下。
telescope 意为“望远镜”，指实验室里每一架旁边的那一架，每一架旁边都有同一支细细的试管。
telescope 意为“望远镜”，指最远那张实验台的留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
telescope 意为“望远镜、眼界”，指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这架眼界就是那件事的全部。
telescope 意为“眼界”，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西而不是那架望远镜，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
telescope 意为“望远镜”，指研究报告里写到、被记下的那一架，到 1983 年这一架成了研究报告里的一行。
telescope 意为“望远镜之事”，研究员二月写道，整件事的望远镜之事是一处实验室和三个学期的记下。
telescope 意为“望远镜”，我记得的是研究报告里记下过的那一架，1985 年测定了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一架。
telescope 为抽象总称，母亲 1987 年说，望远镜是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的望远镜。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1978 年那位研究员用了实验室里没有一位学生肯记下的一架望远镜，他说这一遍才是那个学期的全部。（use the telescope）
那架望远镜，指的是那架望远镜本身而不是细细的试管，经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记下。（telescope）
那处实验室里每一架望远镜旁边都有同一支细细的试管。（telescope）
最远那张实验台那架望远镜，指的是他们留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（telescope）
叔叔说这架眼界就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那架望远镜。（telescope）
1987 年母亲说，望远镜是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的望远镜。（telescope）
